授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: The course provides fundamentals in drawing and design for mechanical and aerospace engineering.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Machine drawing, Mechanical engineering, Aerospace engineering
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
This course has a prerequisite of Drawings on Technical Design I and II, and is only available to those who are required to take it.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.定期試験:
Performance will be evaluated on the basis of assignments, design report and drawing for design project.
The final grade for the course will be calculated approximately as follows:
Assignments 20%
Design project 60% (including design report and drawing)
General Evaluation 20%
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考:
Performance will be evaluated on the basis of class participation, assignments, design report and drawing for design project.
The final grade for the course will be calculated approximately as follows:
Assignments 20%
Design project 60% (including design report and drawing)
General Evaluation 20%
